free_tier_limits.correction: No ongoing free tier. PredictHQ offers a 14-day free trial, after which API access ends unless the user upgrades to a paid plan.

rate_limits.correction: Plan-specific requests per second, measured over a one-second window and applied organization-wide; excess requests may receive HTTP 429.

description.correction: PredictHQ provides structured real-world event data and demand-aware features for forecasting, machine learning, and AI systems.

notes: The API is active; an unauthenticated HTTP 401 is expected and does not indicate downtime. Current official documentation and OpenAPI materials still use https://api.predicthq.com and /v1 endpoints. No official shutdown or replacement notice was found. Authentication uses an API token/key as an HTTP Bearer credential. CORS behavior was not documented authoritatively.
